title: gantt: a parentField that is a lookup does not nest, because ObjectGantt passes the auto-expanded row object through as the task's parent instead of its id
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Priority p2. Measured on 18.5.0 by HotCRM PSA phase 2a (hotcrm#2549, the new `crm_project_task` with a `parent_task` self-lookup). Read again on main.

**What happens.** A Gantt whose `parentField` names a lookup draws every task flat: summary tasks do not nest their subtasks. This shows on both the object-gantt block and the gantt list view.

**Cause (code).** `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx:1544`:

```ts
parent: parentField ? record[parentField] ?? null : undefined,
```

ObjectGantt auto-`$expand`s lookups, so `record[parentField]` is the expanded row object, not its id. The tree keys parents by id, so nothing matches. The same component's siblings already read through the object:
- `normalizeDependencies` reads `.id`, so predecessor links draw correctly;
- `ObjectTree.parentIdOf` reads `.id`, so the tree view nests the same rows.

**Ask.** Read the id off an object parent (`.id`, falling back to `._id`), as `normalizeDependencies` does. Pin it with a Gantt test whose `parentField` is an expanded lookup.

**Re-check.** Add a `gantt` view on an object with a self-lookup parent, seed a parent and a child, and see whether the child renders under the parent.

HotCRM changes nothing when this lands. Its docs point users to the Task Tree view for the hierarchy until then.
